svg.text: Composite schematic, not to scale: detector under the window (left), SNSPD contact (middle), mirror ground via under the Au ground fill (right).
HR Si ρ > 20 kΩ·cm; step 1 removed
the Al mirror and mark go
Al on the resist and in the openings
Al mirror; Al mark at the die edge
HSQ mask, CF₄ etch; HSQ stays
on the wires; 130 nm, 200 nm pitch
(160 nm over the wires with the HSQ)
Ar pre-clean, Ti 10 nm / Au 350 nm
lift-off in NMP; 5 µm gaps open
Au on the 238 nm SiO₂ spacer and
110 nm SiO₂ cap, on base SiO₂ / HR Si.
No Al and no NbN under the Au.
Ar pre-clean, Ti 15 nm / Au 50 nm
Ar etch of the Au seed,
Steps 1, 9, 10, 16a and 16 are removed in v4: step 1 (Si-etch marks), step 9 (10 µm SiO₂ D2),
step 10 (ITO), steps 16a and 16 (layer-45 protect patch, gap etch).
Electrode Au is open: E1 (row 4) and E2 (row 5) are drawn with equal weight.
Layers accumulate from panel to panel. Captions give the process values.
Step 3, Al mirror and marks: resist, evaporate 100 nm Al, lift-off. Al mark (layer 1 shapes, written with layer 10).
electrode Au: choose E1 or E2 (open)
